personal.name: Dinesh Guragain
personal.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
personal.tagline: Building robust, scalable web applications with clean architecture and modern technologies.
personal.bio: I'm a passionate Full Stack .NET Developer with 6+ years of experience crafting enterprise-grade web applications. I specialize in building end-to-end solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and modern frontend frameworks. I thrive on writing clean, maintainable code and transforming complex business requirements into elegant digital experiences.

experience.description: Leading a team of 5 developers to build and maintain enterprise ERP solutions using .NET 8 and Blazor. Architected microservices-based backend serving 50k+ daily active users.
highlights: Reduced API response time by 40% through query optimization and Redis caching
Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, cutting deployment time by 60%
Mentored 3 junior developers and conducted code reviews

experience.description: Developed RESTful APIs and web applications for fintech clients using ASP.NET Core and Angular. Managed end-to-end project delivery in an Agile environment.
highlights: Built a payment gateway integration processing 10k+ transactions daily
Migrated legacy .NET Framework apps to .NET Core, improving performance by 35%
Designed and implemented role-based access control system

experience.description: Started my professional journey building web applications with ASP.NET MVC and jQuery. Gained foundational experience in full software development lifecycle.
highlights: Developed 5+ client-facing web applications from scratch
Created reusable component libraries reducing development time by 25%
Participated in database design and optimization for SQL Server
